description: The Gödel–Gentzen translation \(A\mapsto A^{\mathsf N}\) acts on every full native first-order formula and available bound scope. It double-negates equality and relation atoms, translated disjunctions and translated existentials; it preserves falsum, conjunction, implication and the universal constructor, and sends primitive negation to negation of the translated child. Atomic term trees and bound slots are retained.
